scope: one-dimensional connected runs on the ten sampled total-pulse settings at one resonant timing; not two-dimensional tau-depth topology and not XY8-specific phase cycling

bootstrap.reported_error_assumption: reported error-bar half widths are treated as one standard deviation
bootstrap.normalization: each realization divided by its own minimum
bootstrap.correlation_assumption: errors at different depths are independent

no_fit_statement: Neither pulse fidelity, overhead, coherence parameters, nor horizontal position is fitted to the digitized optimum.
separation_statement: The Farfurnik conventional-XY8 holdout is not included in this topology analysis; it remains a separate short-free-evolution pulse-error mechanism check.
interpretation_limit: Adjacency connects consecutive published sample locations despite unequal pulse-count gaps. The bootstrap propagates reported vertical uncertainty but cannot reveal an unmeasured performance excursion between sampled depths.

source.citation: L. M. Pham et al., Enhanced solid-state multi-spin metrology using dynamical decoupling, Physical Review B 86, 045214 (2012).

independence_statement: Pham et al. (2012) was not directly cited as a source for the explicit values in the existing Table 1 scenario files and no parameter is adjusted to its measured optimum. The project's review references may discuss this experiment, so this is described as a holdout trend validation rather than a claim of complete bibliographic independence.
